title: Analyst solution (SPEC 5.3)
description: A blind solution from the question and options only. Sent as is to output_config.format, so it uses only keywords that structured outputs support (D39).

solving_thought_process.description: Step-by-step solution in plain language, as a coach explains it to a student of grades 1-4. The student sees it after answering.

solver_code.description: A short Python program that checks every option A-E by brute force from the conditions of the task and prints a JSON list of the correct options as its last line, e.g. ["C"]. It runs without network and with a time limit.
